name: NDE Network of Terms
description: Terminology agent for the NDE Network of Terms (Termennetwerk): search, look up and reconcile Dutch cultural heritage terms in AAT, CHT, RKDartists, GTAA, NTA, GeoNames, Wikidata, Iconclass and about fifty more sources.

skills.name: List Sources
skills.description: List the terminology sources with genres, languages, availability and reconciliation support.

skills.name: Search Terms
skills.description: Search up to 10 sources for terms matching a text query; exact label matches first.

skills.name: Look Up Terms
skills.description: Resolve known term URIs to labels, definitions, hierarchy and exactMatch links.

skills.name: Reconcile Names
skills.description: Match names (optionally with birth/death dates, places and relatives) against one source, with scores (W3C Reconciliation API).

skills.name: Fetch Term Properties
skills.description: Fetch selected properties (labels, hierarchy, dates, places, coordinates) for matched term URIs.
